name: Prevent Sleep
description: Prevent the system from entering sleep mode when there are active streams.

versions.changelog:
* Support for Linux. Please read the [instructions](https://github.com/jonschz/jellyfin-plugin-preventsleep/blob/0a8386c74ecac045d398fbd47c3aa21fdc17ad3b/docs/Linux.md) since additional setup will most likely be required, and not every Linux setup is supported.
* Support for Modern Standby in Windows
* Support for Jellyfin 10.9. Note that this version is **not** compatible with Jellyfin 10.8 or older.
* Latest version supporting Jellyfin 10.8. Note that this version is **not** compatible with Jellyfin 10.9 or newer.
